ck_location_mapping_confidence.name: ck_location_mapping_confidence
ck_location_mapping_confidence.value: confidence IS NULL OR (confidence >= 0 AND confidence <= 1)

ck_asset_not_self_parent.name: ck_asset_not_self_parent
ck_asset_not_self_parent.value: parent_asset_id IS NULL OR parent_asset_id <> id

ck_asset_ha_link_target.name: ck_asset_ha_link_target
ck_asset_ha_link_target.value: (link_kind = 'device') = (ha_device_id IS NOT NULL AND ha_entity_registry_id IS NULL)

ck_asset_placement_color.name: ck_asset_placement_color
ck_asset_placement_color.value: color_override IS NULL OR color_override GLOB '#[0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f]'

ck_procedure_equipment_note_target.name: ck_procedure_equipment_note_target
ck_procedure_equipment_note_target.value: asset_id IS NOT NULL OR asset_model_name IS NOT NULL

ck_procedure_reference_pages.name: ck_procedure_reference_pages
ck_procedure_reference_pages.value: page_to IS NULL OR (page_from IS NOT NULL AND page_to >= page_from)

ck_completion_performer.name: ck_completion_performer
ck_completion_performer.value: performed_by_user_id IS NOT NULL OR performed_by_provider_id IS NOT NULL

ux_occ_open_per_plan.name: ux_occ_open_per_plan
ux_occ_open_per_plan.where: plan_id IS NOT NULL AND status IN ('pending', 'due')

ck_occ_window.name: ck_occ_window
ck_occ_window.value: window_end_date IS NULL OR window_start_date IS NOT NULL

ck_plan_one_target.name: ck_plan_one_target
ck_plan_one_target.value: (asset_id IS NOT NULL) + (system_id IS NOT NULL) + (location_id IS NOT NULL) = 1

ck_service_booking_window.name: ck_service_booking_window
ck_service_booking_window.value: scheduled_end_ms IS NULL OR (scheduled_start_ms IS NOT NULL AND scheduled_end_ms >= scheduled_start_ms)

ck_service_document_target.name: ck_service_document_target
ck_service_document_target.value: booking_id IS NOT NULL OR completion_id IS NOT NULL OR asset_id IS NOT NULL

ck_part_reorder_non_negative.name: ck_part_reorder_non_negative
ck_part_reorder_non_negative.value: (reorder_threshold_milli IS NULL OR reorder_threshold_milli >= 0) AND (reorder_target_milli IS NULL OR reorder_target_milli >= 0)

ck_part_compatibility_target.name: ck_part_compatibility_target
ck_part_compatibility_target.value: asset_id IS NOT NULL OR asset_model_name IS NOT NULL

ck_part_lot_estimate_pct.name: ck_part_lot_estimate_pct
ck_part_lot_estimate_pct.value: estimate_pct IS NULL OR (estimate_pct BETWEEN 0 AND 100)

ck_annotation_measurement.name: ck_annotation_measurement
ck_annotation_measurement.value: kind <> 'measurement' OR measurement_value IS NOT NULL

ck_project_costs.name: ck_project_costs
ck_project_costs.value: (budget_cents IS NULL OR budget_cents >= 0) AND (actual_cost_cents IS NULL OR actual_cost_cents >= 0)

ck_project_dates.name: ck_project_dates
ck_project_dates.value: ended_on IS NULL OR started_on IS NOT NULL

ck_condition_rule_threshold.name: ck_condition_rule_threshold
ck_condition_rule_threshold.value: threshold_pct IS NULL OR (threshold_pct BETWEEN 0 AND 100)

ck_condition_rule_clear_threshold.name: ck_condition_rule_clear_threshold
ck_condition_rule_clear_threshold.value: clear_threshold_pct IS NULL OR (clear_threshold_pct BETWEEN 0 AND 100 AND (threshold_pct IS NULL OR clear_threshold_pct > threshold_pct))

ck_condition_rule_sustain.name: ck_condition_rule_sustain
ck_condition_rule_sustain.value: (sustain_minutes IS NULL OR sustain_minutes >= 0) AND (clear_sustain_minutes IS NULL OR clear_sustain_minutes >= 0)

ck_condition_rule_scope_target.name: ck_condition_rule_scope_target
ck_condition_rule_scope_target.value: (scope = 'asset') <= (asset_id IS NOT NULL) AND (scope = 'entity') <= (ha_entity_registry_id IS NOT NULL)

ux_ha_entity_unique_id.name: ux_ha_entity_unique_id
ux_ha_entity_unique_id.where: unique_id IS NOT NULL AND removed_at_ms IS NULL

ux_action_replay.name: ux_action_replay
ux_action_replay.where: nonce IS NOT NULL AND validation = 'accepted'

part_stock.name: part_stock
part_stock.definition:
SELECT p.id AS part_id,
       COALESCE(SUM(t.qty_milli), 0) AS on_hand_milli,
       COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.occurred_at_ms <= unixepoch() * 1000 THEN t.qty_milli END), 0) AS effective_milli,
       MAX(t.occurred_at_ms) AS last_movement_ms
FROM part p LEFT JOIN stock_transaction t ON t.part_id = p.id
GROUP BY p.id
